name: sinemacula/coding-standards
description: Centralized coding standards, static analysis configurations, and code quality tooling for all Sine Macula repositories.

suggest.phpstan/phpstan-phpunit: PHPUnit-aware PHPStan rules: data-provider validation, setUp()/tearDown() parent calls, assertSame discipline, and @covers / mock target existence. Auto-registers via phpstan/extension-installer.
suggest.phpstan/extension-installer: Auto-registers the shared PHPStan config and installed PHPStan extensions (required for the shared phpstan.neon to load).
